mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, lock_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, locked_by VARCHAR(128), locked_until TIMESTAMP(3), hold_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, gmt_create TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_${tableName}_lock_name UNIQUE (lock_name) )
mapper.select: SELECT lock_name AS lockName, locked_by AS ownerId, hold_count AS holdCount, locked_until AS lockedUntil, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM ${tableName} WHERE locked_by IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lock_name
